summary: Turn raw motion-corrected zebrafish calcium fluorescence into ΔF/F₀ using a Gaussian-smoothed running-minimum baseline, then average per neuron down to one time series per atlas brain region, and render the stacked anterior-to-posterior ridge plot of regional traces with the visual-stimulus window marked.
use_when: Analyze δf/f₀ extraction and regional averaging from raw calcium traces
Generate δf/f₀ extraction and regional averaging from raw calcium traces outputs
avoid_when: The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
